# Musme

> Musme builds AI systems, content, and digital products for owner-led businesses, especially in healthcare and restaurants.

- [Musme home](https://www.musme.co/): services, selected work, products, and how a project works
- [About Musme](https://www.musme.co/about): company, founder Haider Jalal, industries, and operating approach
- [AI automation](https://www.musme.co/services/ai-automation): workflows, integrations, healthcare examples, and restaurant examples
- [Website and software development](https://www.musme.co/services/web-development): websites, apps, AI menus, portals, and custom software
- [AI content services](https://www.musme.co/services/ai-content): AI image generation, AI video generation, and social media systems
- [Case studies](https://www.musme.co/case-studies): selected client websites and Musme products
- [Contact Musme](https://www.musme.co/contact): email and project quote form
- [Full text version](https://www.musme.co/llms-full.txt): the whole site in one markdown file
- [Test Shift](https://testshift.musme.co/): rent an AI QA team by the hour
- [Citable](https://citable.musme.co/): see which parts of a page AI search crawlers can read
- [PDFDesk](https://pdfdesk.musme.co/): edit PDFs like a Word document
- [Dressify](https://dressify.musme.co/): find nearby tailors and women-led home ateliers for bespoke clothing

Contact: hello@musme.ai
